The 2015+ Kawasaki H2 fairings consists of a set of panels attached to the Kawasaki Ninja H2 motorcycle, which main function is to reduce air resistance, thereby increasing speed and reducing fuel consumption. In addition, the 2015+ Kawasaki H2 fairing kit can also protect the body and the engine of motorcycle and protect the rider from the wind, avoid frostbite or hypothermia etc. during driving. The carbon fiber fairing Ninja H2 can freely combine the front fairing, body fairing kit, rear fairing, etc. according to your own needs, its light weight, high strength and excellent comprehensive performance have been widely used and recognized in motorcycle applications.

  • 3K dry carbon fiber material to make sure the Kawasaki H2 full fairing is lightweight, high strength, high temperature resistant and UV resistant.
  • 3D scanning for original 2015 Kawasaki Ninja H2 parts, high-precision mold to meet 100% OEM fitment.
